items.title: Clarence Ford Interview, 1975-12-10
items.q: at the time I didn't know Musgraat and Rambo, but we played tunes of that order.

ctx.x: I would just have called it music. Music, yeah.

But they would play the tunes at the time, because it was, once it hadn't been too long that people were playing those tunes as everyday music. But now it's like Dixieland or Rock or something, but they didn't have all that. And Sheep, we played, like Caldonia was a blues out then, the closest thing to rhythm and blues. We played Caldonia. Yeah. And we might have played, at the time I didn't know Musgraat and Rambo, but we played tunes of that order. Musgraat and Rambo, like played the Sheik of Araby, and we…
Did you have a, when you were playing, you said you only played a couple times a month,
